channel.title: White-Hat Prankster
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "White-Hat Prankster" - A safe SCP that loves pranks and benefits the foundation.

item.title: Re: Pranking Mimic
item.content:encoded:
This is definitely a step in the right direction!

It's now narratively and conceptually distinct from 2006, but I do believe the central narrative is lacking a little in your description. The development of this creature from a nuisance the foundation that they just can't contain without extraordinary cost (What did they try? This is an interesting bit for me at least) to a tool for them to test containment will make up a majority of the article, but I feel like this could be explained better/more linearly - you have 400 words, might as well use them.

Overall I think this could make for a great cute, 'breath of fresh air' scp and definitely stands a lot better than it did.

item.title: Re: Pranking Mimic
item.content:encoded:
Discussed the idea and possible clashes with SCP-2006 on irc.

To pick up back where I had to go, I don't believe focusing on the creature's origins/octopusness is a particularly strong idea unless you have a real cracking idea of a good/powerful narrative from this (why it does what it does etc. in a compelling way). I can't personally think of where I would take this, but as I mentioned in IRC, this has a very similar 'narrative spine' to 2006 right now, not just abilities - even if it's complete coincidence. This needs to be made much more distinct. My only thought is perhaps the foundation, without the constant threat that 2006 poses, does not concede to your octopus and humour it, and how that would affect it/how it would react, but that is just one idea, I would recommend you try and come up with your own way to take it.

I would really advise thinking of other ways you could take this creature, even after cutting it's want to scare things to more a jovial prankster. If you'd like to bounce ideas about this, feel free to shoot me a DM here or on IRC if I'm about.

GL with your writing :)

item.title: White-Hat Prankster.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Comedy/lighthearted/fun

Elevator Pitch:

  • Can escape from almost all containment measures.
  • It is a notorious prankster
  • Has light memetic properties
  • Can contort/shapeshift body to take various shapes including other SCP or tools.
  • It is non-malevolent SCP that benefits the foundation.
  • Based off Octopuses(they escape tanks/are naturally curious/can shape change)
  • Safe

Central Narrative:
The foundation finds this SCP(either from aquarium/research center/ appears on their doorstep) and contains it. Only to start finding childish pranks being pulled around the site with an unknown snicker following. Water buckets over doorways, Gum under door handles, childish sticky notes, kick me signs on researcher's back. When they review tapes they note the SCP breaks containment and then returns back after completing the pranks. They put it in more secure containment. Only to see no matter what measures they put in place, it escapes. It doesn't escape via teleporting, phasing or anything like that. It will social engineer, pick locks, trick, squeeze through tiny gaps..ect..ect.

A researcher takes notice they begin experimenting on it. Then they start to use it to test containment chambers and reward it. They will at times use it to test security at other sites. Since it is clear, this SCP could have left the site at anytime it chose to. The SCP becomes attached to a particular researcher and will often escape to be near them.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
It is a friendly SCP that benefits the foundation with a lighthearted/fun story.
